name: kilowattrel
flavor: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

abilities.name: wind-power
abilities.effect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

abilities.name: volt-absorb
abilities.effect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: competitive
abilities.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
